build_quantized_linear_layer: build a QuantLinear module with 4-bit GPTQ quantization for a given in/out feature size
run_quantized_matmul: run the matmul248 function to compute a quantized matrix multiplication on GPU
pack_linear_weights: pack a standard linear layer's weights into GPTQ quantized format using QuantLinear.pack
create_quantized_layer_from_scratch: create an empty QuantLinear layer using the QuantLinear.new class method with specified bits and groupsize
review_triton_kernel: review the matmul_248_kernel Triton JIT kernel for 2/4/8-bit quantized GEMM computation
